scope: claude-mem, OpenCode, Supermemory, RLM, IPython, Mastra, Paperclip, Hermes, Kanban, Graphify, Ewin-Tang-style low-rank work, and dev:gpu

claudeMem.note: Not the Parent Atlas durable dispatch owner

openCode.role: MCP/plugin and agent client control surface

supermemory.note: Third-party OpenCode plugin is possible, but not part of the current Parent Atlas runtime

rlm.note: No separate external RLM runtime was found

ipython.note: Not a production Parent Atlas control plane

mastra.note: No @mastra/core dependency; adapter comments identify a compatibility shim

hermes.note: Environment variables and smoke script exist; active runtime ownership remains unproven

kanban.authority: task state and receipts, not canonical source truth

graphify.devGpu: separate startup launcher; graph freshness must come from a completed run receipt

devGpu.note: Launcher integration is distinct from model, graph, and agent memory ownership

boundary: Postgres remains canonical; SearchRuntime owns retrieval fusion; RabbitMQ owns Parent Atlas durable dispatch; Valkey is derived cache; external agent frameworks remain optional control-plane adapters.
